<!-- A test page for the 3D anatomy viewer (assets/js/anatomy-viewer.js).
     To use it in another post, copy the ```{=html} block below and point
     data-organs at that scan's organs.csv. The figure runs wider than the
     text by itself. Making the models for a new scan, and changing labels,
     systems, colours or starting opacities, is under "A 3D anatomy figure"
     in EDITING.md. -->

This page tries out the 3D anatomy viewer on one micro-CT scan of a Kloof frog tadpole, *Natalobatrachus bonebergi* (JRP 058), segmented into its cartilage skull and its upper and lower jaws.

```{=html}
<div class="anatomy-viewer"
     data-organs="../../assets/models/natalobatrachus-bonebergi-jrp058/organs.csv"
     aria-label="Rotatable 3D model of the cartilage skull and jaws of a Kloof frog tadpole, with a menu to switch each part on and off or fade it"></div>
<script type="module" src="../../assets/js/anatomy-viewer.js"></script>
```

::: {.model-caption}
The skull (chondrocranium) and jaws of a Kloof frog tadpole, *Natalobatrachus bonebergi*, from a micro-CT scan. Use the menu to switch parts on and off, fade them with the sliders, or slice through the model.
:::
